name: Trilium Notes
description: Personal knowledge base with rich-text notes, scripts, relation graphs, mind maps and a powerful sync server for your devices.
compose:
services:
  trilium:
    image: zadam/trilium:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/root/trilium-data
    restart: unless-stopped
